 For the Petitioner : Mr. Manish Kumar, Adv.
For the State : Mr. Someshwar Roy, A.P.P.

For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. V.S.Jha, Adv.
 ....
 03/21.07.2023
1.  Heard the parties.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 12.01.2023 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Korrah P.S. Case No.08/2023, registered for the offence under Sections 376/
417 and 420 of IPC.
3. The applicant has been made accused for committing rape upon the victim on the false pretext of marriage.

4. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Earlier the bail application of this applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 09.05.2023 passed in B.A. No.3491 of 2023.
The prayer for bail has been renewed stating that both the parties are major aged about 30 years and 40 years.
The relationship between the parties was consensual and only as a pressure tactics, the present case has been lodged.

On the above basis,
prayer for bail has been renewed.
5. Learned A.P.P. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant and submitted that the consent was fraudulent and offence is made out.

Considering the above facts and the fact that both the parties are major, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M., Hazaribag in connection with Korrah P.S. Case No.08/2023,
subject to the condition that he will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid/
